data.name: Scarlett
data.gender_notes: Scarlett is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old French escarlate, 'scarlet', an occupational or colour name. Its root is Old French escarlate. A modern English given name. Scarlett is a English name meaning “Scarlet; red cloth seller”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Scarlett expresses “Scarlet; red cloth seller”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Old French escarlate, 'scarlet', an occupational or colour name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Scarlett total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
